source: New MIT synthetic figures; no published or real-figure validation claim
split_unit: base figure; every derivative stays in its base split
ordinary: Single rectangular biological-layout matrix, 20/25/30 genes, 6/8/10 samples, opaque white background, upright separated text, one continuous linear bar, 3/5/7 ticks, no grid or 1px grid. Both colourbar directions. All bar sides and orientations. Clean, Gaussian blur sigma 0.65px and JPEG quality 85 are all ordinary, regardless of detector success.
evaluation_order: Runtime decisions first, truth scoring afterwards. Test runs only after code/policy freeze. No tuning after test. Four modes use the deployed pipeline; inferred modes receive no true dimensions or boxes.
